findings.title: Redundant list conversion causes unnecessary copy
findings.body: The return statement wraps the result of `sorted` in a `list()` call, which is redundant because `sorted` already returns a list. This creates an unnecessary shallow copy of the list, wasting time and memory. Remove the redundant call and return `sorted(set(check_runs))` directly.

summary.problem: The change introduces an unnecessary list copy in the return statement, causing a minor performance inefficiency.
summary.done_well: The function still correctly returns a sorted list of unique check runs.
